court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Sub-ordinate Judge, Mettupalayam, Coimbatore District (HMOP No.36 of 2019)
facts_of_case: The parties are husband and wife who got married in 2015. The wife filed a divorce petition under the Hindu Marriage Act, seeking divorce due to misunderstanding and dispute between the spouses. During pendency of the petition, the wife sought interim maintenance and litigation expenses. The trial court partly allowed the wife's application and directed the husband to pay Rs.3,000/- towards monthly interim maintenance and Rs.10,000/- towards litigation expenses.

legal_principles.principle: A husband is bound by duty to maintain his wife while she is living separately without any income.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner should not escape from the duty of family raising the grounds of no income on the side of the petitioner and other reasons till the disposal of H.M.O.P.No.36 of 2019 which is pending before the Court below.

legal_principles.principle: Interim maintenance can be awarded to a respondent wife even if the income of the petitioner husband is not proved.
legal_principles.held: The Court below is constrained to award interim maintenance to the respondent wife as the petitioner being husband is bound duty to maintain his wife while she is living separately without any income and would have met expenses to lead her life.

outcome.final_order: The trial court order dated 30.09.2020 was not set aside.
